description.text: Program Description This program is designed to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in international economy and trade, familiar with the latest developments in the field of international trade of the modern world, able to handle international business and economic cooperation, and qualified for careers in business, management, research, as well as publicity in economic and trade organizations. Major Courses: Political Economics, Western Economics, International Economics, Econometrics, Introduction to World Economy, International Trade Theory and Practice, International Finance, International Settlement, Monetary Banking, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor's Degree in Economics

duration.text: The International Economy and Trade at Chengdu University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Application Materials 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript High school graduate certificate 5.Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: Entry Requirements 1.High school graduate 2.HSK level 4 or above
